resources.string: X-MAN field node: manual test capture and foreground visual monitoring. This app does NOT detect landslides: it only reports persistent visual change as evidence candidates. X-MAN decides what an event is.
Camera access is required to capture field evidence.
Location is used to attach evidence to the registered field node location. Without it, evidence is sent without GPS and X-MAN uses the node\'s registered location.

Visual monitoring (M-LIVE-04): detects persistent local visual change only. It is NOT landslide detection, not a prediction and not an emergency alert. X-MAN and its reviewers decide what an event is.
